blurb: Guests fish for salmon, steelhead, and sturgeon on guided trips in Portland and nearby rivers including the Columbia, Willamette, Clackamas, Lewis, and Cowlitz. Trips run year-round with seasonal species availability. All fishing gear, tackle, and bait are provided, and the guide cleans and filets the catch.
